output.reason: The cited list item [ev-409448afd2c6] is only a bare metric name, but its section intro [ev-1f419676f177] gives the concrete change. That intro says the listed `cortex_`-prefixed metrics now start with `loki_` in this release, so this metric becomes `loki_query_scheduler_inflight_requests_count`. It also says exposure depends on `metrics_namespace` staying at its default `loki`: setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name, and that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. If the operator does nothing, the metric is published under the new name, so anything that queries the old name stops matching it. Whether the subject schema can represent a metric name is a modelling question, not a gap in the evidence.
